notes.title: Strange And Mysterious Domain Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We’ve released a new update for the Strange And Mysterious Domain demo. This version focuses on dialogue improvements, a complete UI overhaul, and several critical bug fixes.
Optimizations[olist]
Polished many story dialogues for smoother narrative flow.

Rebuilt all UI interfaces to enhance visuals and interaction.
[/olist]Bug Fixes[olist]
Fixed misaligned textures in certain objects at the Forest Entrance.

Fixed pixel-shift errors inside the Detective’s Office.

Fixed a softlock issue on the right side outside the Detective’s Office.

Fixed a bug where players could repeatedly obtain unlimited items from the Fisherman.

Fixed a softlock during dialogues in Room 301.

Fixed misaligned textures in certain objects near the Lake.

Fixed an issue where certain dialogue choices could cause infinite loops.

Fixed an issue preventing access to the Apartment Exterior under specific conditions.
[/olist]
Thank you all for your valuable feedback and support. We hope you enjoy exploring the Strange And Mysterious Domain!
